points.text: Testifying that 'There is no god but Allah' is the most superior act of worship and the most beloved speech to Allah, carrying immense reward and weight on the Day of Judgment.
Sincere declaration of monotheism guarantees entry into Paradise and protects the believer from Hellfire, serving as a divine guarantee and a fortress against chastisement.
The profession of monotheism erases sins, accumulates good deeds, and elevates spiritual status, with specific repetitions yielding massive recorded rewards.
The declaration of monotheism has cosmic significance, causing the Throne to tremble and divine forgiveness to be proclaimed, while also serving as the primary right of Allah upon His servants.
The statement 'There is no god but Allah' is the price or condition for Paradise, with sincerity defined as refraining from forbidden acts, and insincerity resulting in Hellfire.
Refusal to acknowledge monotheism characterizes stubborn tyrants, while contemplation of creation leads to recognizing the Creator, reinforcing the core message of divine oneness.
